baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional construction joins istiqamu, al-tariqa, asqaynahum, ma'an, and ghadaqan as one path-to-water sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Even alignment along an extended way opens an irrigation channel: rectified course, routed supply, appearing water, and abundant outpouring form a single hydraulic mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Straightness, uprightness, and evenness supply the aligned condition expressed by istiqamu.
The extended way gives the alignment a continuous course rather than an isolated posture.
An irrigation share and its channel turn divine watering into routed, distributable supply.
Water appearing, entering, or becoming abundant supplies the released medium in the channel.
Abundant outpouring makes the result plenitude rather than a minimal drink.

changed_reading.before: Correct conduct is followed by a generic gift of plentiful rain.
changed_reading.after: Straight alignment removes a routing obstruction and lets abundant provision run through a way-shaped supply channel.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The durative feel of istiqama on a tariqa can be read together with the supplied watering source and abundant water.
baseline_models.mechanism: Maintenance and subsistence in the standing root combine with a habitual course and an installed watering source, pairing sustained practice with sustained life-support rather than a one-time transaction.

activation_trace.role: Care, guardianship, and preservation make istiqama an actively maintained condition.
Support, mainstay, and subsistence connect uprightness to what keeps life standing.
A habitual course gives the path temporal persistence.
Providing a watering source makes the result an enduring facility, not merely a cup.
Abundant outpouring gives the maintained source ample capacity.

changed_reading.before: A completed act of obedience earns a one-time material reward.
changed_reading.after: A maintained course is paired with a maintained source of subsistence, so continuity answers continuity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ma'an ghadaqan intensifies the outcome beyond bare relief of thirst.
baseline_models.mechanism: A rain-heavy source produces visible freshness and luxuriant softness, making the water a medium of flourishing that exceeds survival.

activation_trace.role: The rain-heavy cloud supplies a large-scale source of saturation.
A water-like sheen of freshness in face, speech, and fruit supplies the visible effect of watering.
Luxuriant softness defines the abundance as ease and flourishing, not bare quantity.

changed_reading.before: The promised water is simply enough water to meet need.
changed_reading.after: The promised saturation produces freshness, softness, and cultivated flourishing beyond subsistence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventories themselves connect water with freshness in speech and ghadaq with profuse speech.
baseline_models.mechanism: Straight or just expression, patterned striking, freshness in speech, and profuse utterance allow the water phrase to carry an exploratory verbal register: disciplined form releases abundant discourse.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and just speech supply disciplined verbal alignment.
Patterned striking contributes cadence or ordered articulation to the course.
Water-like freshness in speech supplies the direct bridge from water to utterance.
Profuse speech turns ghadaq's abundance into verbal outpouring.

changed_reading.before: The clause concerns material water alone.
changed_reading.after: Alongside material water, it can image an abundant, fresh outpouring of speech released through disciplined form.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gentle guidance toward a path and rushd as straight guidance precede a description of differentiated routes. Against that plurality, the focus's definite singular way becomes a convergence from fragmented courses into one rectified trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and evenness anchor the convergent posture in istiqamu.
The extended way anchors the singular destination-course in the focus.
Gentle indication toward the path and truth supplies directional guidance into the focus route.
Straightness of path away from error identifies the route's orienting quality.
The same extended-way image makes the earlier plural paths directly comparable with the focus's singular way.
Divergent paths and groups supply the fragmentation that the focus's straight singular course resolves.

structural_cues: 72:2 makes guidance to rushd the first response to hearing.
72:11 places plural differentiated paths before the definite singular al-tariqa in 72:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guidance, straight-path rushd, plural differentiated routes, and a later definite singular route; I infer a convergence from plurality to alignment. The live alternative is that al-tariqa names a known norm without implying a temporal convergence.

changed_reading.before: People already on a generic path are asked merely to remain well behaved.
changed_reading.after: Differentiated groups are imagined as becoming aligned on one guided trajectory, and that convergence opens the abundant flow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's even measure and irrigation share are activated by the refusal of diminished right and by qist's opposed possibilities of injustice and apportionment. Straightness becomes distributive rectitude, while abundant water becomes a life-supporting share that is not withheld.

activation_trace.role: Equal weight and even measure give istiqama a distributive geometry.
The irrigation share and channel make water an apportioned common provision.
Abundant outpouring ensures that equitable allocation is not an economy of scarcity.
Diminution of a due right supplies the deprivation that faithful alignment excludes.
Land or crop left without irrigation materializes diminished right as withheld water.
Injustice and deviation from right supply the social tilt opposed to straight allocation.
Share and apportionment connect the moral contrast to distribution of the focus provision.

structural_cues: 72:13 pairs trust with freedom from shortfall, and 72:14-15 immediately divide submitters from the qasitun.
The focus follows that division with a conditional plural and an explicitly abundant resource.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-diminution, injustice, apportionment, even measure, and an irrigation share; I infer that the path includes just resource relations. The alternative is that the legal-social roots remain moral contrasts without specifying water distribution.

changed_reading.before: Abundant water is an undifferentiated reward delivered to a compliant group.
changed_reading.after: The water images a just ecology in which alignment prevents diminished shares and abundance is distributed without deprivation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding image of dried, combustible material is reversed by appearing, abundant water. The conditional therefore separates two material trajectories: desiccation fit for fuel and saturation fit for flourishing.

activation_trace.role: Water entering and becoming abundant supplies the saturating side of the material reversal.
Luxuriant softness supplies the living texture opposite dried fuel.
Emaciation like dry firewood supplies the desiccated material state that water reverses.

structural_cues: 72:15 ends with hataban and 72:16 ends with ma'an ghadaqan, placing fuel-dryness and saturation back to back.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent fuel and abundant-water images; I infer a deliberate material reversal between drying and saturation. The live alternative is that the two outcomes are adjacent but not intended as a shared material analogy.

changed_reading.before: The water promise is an isolated positive image after an unrelated punishment image.
changed_reading.after: The focus turns the prior dry-fuel state inside out: alignment moves the subjects from combustible desiccation toward saturated flourishing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next purpose clause makes the abundant medium itself an assay. Plenty is therefore neither simple payment nor proof of approval; exposure to the flow is what reveals or forms the recipients' response.

activation_trace.role: The provided watering source supplies the enduring medium in which the recipients are placed.
Entering and abundant water makes the trial immersive rather than momentary.
Abundant outpouring identifies plenitude itself as the test condition.
Assaying metal or a person turns the antecedent abundance into an instrument of disclosure.

structural_cues: 72:17 opens with a purpose clause, linaftinahum fihi, whose pronoun points back into the focus provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies testing in the antecedent medium; I infer that conduct under abundance, not abundance alone, discloses alignment. The exact tested response remains open and could be gratitude, restraint, remembrance, or another use of plenty.

changed_reading.before: Plentiful water confirms approval and closes the conditional with reward.
changed_reading.after: Plentiful water opens a new phase: abundance is an assay whose use reveals whether straightness persists.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus route and irrigation channel are mirrored by lateral turning, insertion into a route, and arduous ascent. The two verses form a routing system: alignment admits sustaining flow, while turning aside routes the subject into constriction and climb.

activation_trace.role: Straightness supplies the aligned orientation at the route fork.
The extended way supplies the primary route through the conditional.
The irrigation channel makes the positive route a conduit of sustaining flow.
Turning one's side supplies the lateral departure from the focus alignment.
Crosswise travel and difficulty of straightness sharpen the geometry of deviation.
Inserting one thing into another supplies the act of routing the diverter into a new medium.
The arduous incline gives the negative route resistance and constriction.

structural_cues: 72:16-17 juxtapose istiqama on a way with i'rad and yuslikhu, preserving motion vocabulary on both sides.
The positive result moves as water through a channel; the negative result is grammatically something into which the subject is made to enter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies straight orientation, lateral turning, channel imagery, insertion, and ascent; I infer a mirrored route fork. The alternative is a rhetorical moral contrast with no intended spatial or hydraulic system.

changed_reading.before: Straight conduct earns water, while unrelated turning away earns punishment.
changed_reading.after: Orientation determines routing: alignment opens a sustaining conduit, whereas lateral deviation is threaded into an arduous rising course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene places an upright servant against a crowd layering itself around him. That embodiment feeds back into istiqamu: the focus can describe ordered communal posture maintained under converging social pressure, not only an abstract proposition.

activation_trace.role: Bodily upright standing makes istiqama available as an embodied posture.
Straightness and evenness turn bodily standing into ordered alignment.
The servant's upright standing supplies a concrete later enactment of the focus root.
A dense mass layered one over another supplies the social pressure surrounding the upright figure.

structural_cues: 72:19 repeats q-w-m in a scene where the servant stands while others nearly become a piled mass around him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated standing and a layered crowd; I infer that the later posture concretizes the earlier plural istiqama under pressure. The alternative is that the two q-w-m forms serve separate scenes without reciprocal interpretation.

changed_reading.before: Istiqama is an inward or doctrinal state with no social mechanics.
changed_reading.after: Istiqama is also an embodied capacity to preserve ordered uprightness when a collective compresses and piles around a centered act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus-only speech-water possibility becomes a transmission model: divine news is recited and received with understanding, then conveyed through a threaded messenger route as hidden, pooled knowledge is disclosed. The abundant water can therefore coexist as an image of revelatory flow.

activation_trace.role: The extended way supplies the transmission route.
The irrigation channel gives the transmitted content a conduit and a recipient share.
Water-like freshness in speech licenses the verbal-water bridge.
Profuse speech gives the abundant flow an explicitly verbal register.
Divine news and inspiration supply the source content entering the communication system.
Understanding and compliance make hearing reception that changes the hearer, not mere acoustics.
Reading and recitation provide the articulated form of the transmitted flow.
Insertion into a route makes authorized transmission a deliberately threaded channel.
Conveying a message supplies delivery from source to recipients.
Continuous milk-flow supplies a sustained-stream image inside the messenger root.
Much water pooled together turns knowledge into a reservoir available for controlled release.
Emergence and disclosure supply the movement from hidden reservoir to manifest message.

structural_cues: The surah opens with revelation heard as an astonishing recitation and repeatedly links hearing to response.
72:23-28 close with delivery, selected disclosure of the unseen, guarded routing, and verified completion of messages.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, receptive hearing, delivery, threading, hidden knowledge, disclosure, and focus branches for fresh or profuse speech; I infer one communication-flow mechanism. Material water remains a live primary reading, and the epistemic flow should coexist with it rather than replace it.

changed_reading.before: Fresh or profuse speech is only an isolated lexical possibility inside the focus inventories.
changed_reading.after: It becomes a surah-scale transmission model: hidden knowledge is released as abundant recited flow through an authorized route into receptive hearers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final enclosure, exhaustive counting, and totality cues qualify ghadaq. The flow is ample but not chaotic: it remains encompassed, known, and capable of measured allocation through the focus irrigation share.

activation_trace.role: Equal weight and even measure supply order within abundance.
An irrigation share and channel make the abundant whole administrable in portions.
Abundant outpouring supplies the plenitude that the later accounting contains without reducing.
Counting the countable supplies discrete accounting within the plenitude.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and custody supplies the outer bound around the flow.
Exhaustive enumeration ensures that no unit of the administered abundance escapes knowledge.
Total enclosure and completion define the comprehensive scope of the accounting.

structural_cues: The surah's final clause moves from encompassing what is with the messengers to exhaustively counting every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies abundant flow, measured irrigation share, encompassing, totality, and exhaustive count; I infer that final accounting back-qualifies the water as governed abundance. The alternative is that the closure governs messages and deeds without commenting on material provision.

changed_reading.before: Ghadaq suggests an unbounded overflow whose sheer quantity is the point.
changed_reading.after: The abundance is inexhaustibly ample yet fully encompassed, measured, and distributable rather than uncontrolled.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant s-q-y to s-w-q mapping and a distant running branch of ghadaq. It remains anchored in the focus's exact watering word, path construction, and abundance adjective, but downstream prose should label it a split-root motion experiment rather than a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence istiqamu, al-tariqa, asqaynahum, ghadaqan can support motion as well as reception when the split watering root is retained.

activation_trace.role: Resolve and rising to undertake a matter supply readiness for forward movement.
The extended way supplies the course along which movement proceeds.
Driving and impelling forward recasts the supplied flow as motive force.
Following one after another turns the movement into sustained collective progression.
Forceful running gives the abundant current kinetic intensity.

changed_reading.before: Water is a static benefit received after alignment.
changed_reading.after: The abundant current is an impelling force that carries aligned subjects forward, one after another, along the extended way.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the promise root reaches the perennial-water image through a split mapped target, and the same image reappears under counting. It remains anchored by the focus's habitual course, watering source, and abundant water, but downstream prose should present it only as a temporal branch activation, not as the direct sense of the promise verses.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A habitual tariqa answered by a supplied source leaves open whether ma'an ghadaqan is recurrent rather than a single event.

activation_trace.role: A habitual course supplies the repeated temporal pattern to be answered.
Providing a watering source makes continuity possible beyond one drink.
Abundant outpouring supplies the volume of the enduring provision.
The perennial-water branch inside the split promise mapping adds durability to what is awaited.
The same perennial-water image under counting carries the durability through the closing accounting.

changed_reading.before: The focus promises one exceptional inundation at an unspecified moment.
changed_reading.after: The habitual course may be answered by a recurrent or perennial source whose duration is part of the promise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-material reading is strange because it combines cloth dyeing, metallic wash, luxuriant texture, and human or metal assay. It remains anchored in three focus words and the explicit test clause, but downstream prose should qualify it as an experimental saturation analogy rather than identify the water literally with dye or plating.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Asqaynahum, ma'an, and ghadaqan each contain material branches that can describe saturation changing a recipient's visible state.

activation_trace.role: Soaking cloth with dye supplies saturation that alters the recipient rather than merely relieving thirst.
A gold or silver wash on metal supplies a coating that makes exposure visibly legible.
Luxuriant softness supplies the transformed texture produced by saturation.
Assaying metal or a person turns the saturating exposure into a test of what the recipient becomes or reveals.

changed_reading.before: The recipients consume an external provision whose only relevant property is quantity.
changed_reading.after: The abundant medium saturates and marks its recipients like dye or wash, so the ensuing assay reveals how exposure has formed them.

strongest_changes: The explicit fitna purpose clause overturns a reward-only baseline: abundance itself is the assay.
Guidance and rushd, followed by differentiated plural routes, recast the focus's singular way as guided convergence.
Lateral turning, insertion, and arduous ascent mirror the focus path as a bifurcating routing system.
Non-diminution, apportionment, even measure, and irrigation share activate an equitable-resource reading.
Speech-water branches become a coherent revelatory-flow model under recitation, hearing, delivery, threading, knowledge, and disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus packs alignment, route, irrigation, water, and abundance into one causal line, while the packet repeatedly reactivates those domains through fragmented paths, distributive rights, testing, guarded transmission, and exhaustive accounting. The split mappings also preserve several contained but genuinely different motion and duration readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Material provision and revelatory flow can coexist, but the packet does not force one to subsume the other.
The plural-to-singular route movement may indicate convergence, or only contrast a known norm with prior diversity.
The purpose clause establishes testing through abundance but leaves the tested response unspecified.
Split-root and cross-material outliers remain branch-valid but should not be promoted to direct lexical glosses.
